tools.name: find_items
tools.description: Finds exact CS2 market_hash_name values (skins, knives, gloves, stickers, cases, agents) from a loose query, e.g. 'ak redline ft', 'karambit doppler fn', 'st m4a1 printstream'. Use it before the price tools, which need exact names. Abbreviations: st = StatTrak, fn/mw/ft/ww/bs = exterior.

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Live lowest listing prices for CS2 items on up to 12 marketplaces (YouPin898, BUFF163, C5Game, EcoSteam, SkinBaron, Skinport, CSFloat, LIS-SKINS, DMarket, ShadowPay, Waxpeer, Market.CSGO) plus the Steam Community Market best ask/bid. Refreshed about every 5 minutes. Prices are in each market's own c

tools.name: get_youpin_buy_orders
tools.description: Current YouPin898 buy orders (bids) for an item, in CNY, refreshed about every 30 minutes. Default: best buy-order price and order count (Pro plan). With detail=true or any float/phase/fade/tier filter: every individual buy order with its float range and conditions (Enterprise plan). Requires an API

tools.name: get_float_ranged_prices
tools.description: YouPin898 lowest listing price per float range (e.g. 0.00-0.01, 0.01-0.02) for an item, in CNY, with Doppler phase and Fade % where relevant. Use it for low-float or high-fade valuations. Requires an API key (Pro plan).

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Daily or hourly price history of one item on one marketplace (lowest listing price and listing count), in the market's currency. Daily covers up to a year and more, hourly up to 30 days. Requires an API key (Enterprise plan).

tools.name: get_recent_sales
tools.description: Recent completed sales of an item on CSFloat, YouPin or Skinport with price, float, pattern (paint seed), stickers and keychains. Filter by float range or pattern. Requires an API key (Enterprise plan).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_recent_sales" references sensitive artifacts (keychain). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
